summary: Burford Capital Global Finance LLC, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Burford Capital Limited, closed a previously announced private offering of $300 million 8.000% senior secured notes due October 15, 2029. The notes are guaranteed on a senior secured basis by Burford Capital and secured by substantially all Issuer assets plus capital stock of certain subsidiaries, under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee and collateral agent. Net proceeds, with cash on hand, will redeem in full the Issuer's 6.250% senior notes due 2028. Interest pays semi-annually from April 15, 2027; covenant package limits debt, liens, dividends and affiliate deals.
